welcome.heading: Welcome to Navin 🎉
welcome.body: This is your logistics command center. Monitor shipments, track performance, and manage your team — all in one place.

createShipment.heading: Create Your First Shipment
createShipment.body: Click here to create a new shipment, assign routes, set milestones, and configure automated settlements.

trackShipments.heading: Track Shipments
trackShipments.body: View all active and historical shipments with real-time on-chain milestone updates and IoT sensor data.

settlements.heading: Automated Settlements
settlements.body: Settlements trigger automatically when delivery milestones are verified on the Stellar blockchain.

wallet.heading: Connect Your Stellar Wallet
wallet.body: Connect your Stellar wallet to sign settlement transactions and interact with Soroban smart contracts.
